title: Universal Asset Picker / Resource Query API
objective: Implement the bounded Universal Asset Picker / Resource Query API: expose one reusable query/picker surface over existing ARI catalog truth, reusing ARI-15 pagination/lazy retrieval and applying availability plus rights/use-capability filtering without minting owner-domain semantics.

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-13
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-19 composes ARI-15 query/pagination/lazy retrieval rather than duplicating its query engine.
Availability and ARI-11 rights/use-capability eligibility are evaluated before picker exposure and page hydration.
Missing, unavailable, revoked, unknown and denied states fail closed and remain explicit findings.
MAI, AAI, CAPP, PAPT and other owner-domain semantics remain owner-owned; ARI-19 returns stable ARI reference projections only.
ARI-19 does not mutate resource identity, provenance, rights or provider entitlement state.
ARI-20 remains selected_not_started until its own governed start.
next_action: ARI-20 is the strict selected_not_started successor. Record its governed start and pass the execution transaction preflight before creating its reserved implementation branch.
